mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag_group ( name, is_multi_select, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{isMultiSelect}, #{sortOrder}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, is_multi_select, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM tag_group WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, is_multi_select, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM tag_group ORDER BY sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC
